title: Bring back previous behaviour of removing images from compaction and new thread summarries
body:
### Reproduction steps I work with an extensive list of AI agents. Some of them support images. While others do not. It was very convenient to work with zed while switching between models. For example, I could use an image capable model to understand the image, then continue working with a different text-only model **after** compaction. The current update of `Zed` has crippled this ability. It has also broken the ability to summarize an old thread which had images with a text-only model. Please bring it back. 1. When I try to compact using a text model: 2. When I try to summarize a thread ### Current vs. Expected behavior Models with text-only capabilities used to be able to continue conversations by image capable models after compaction. They were also able to summarize a thread that contained images. Both of these are no longer possible. Reproduction steps

I work with an extensive list of AI agents.

Some of them support images. While others do not.
It was very convenient to work with zed while switching between models.

For example, I could use an image capable model to understand the image, then continue working with a different text-only model after compaction.

The current update of Zed has crippled this ability.

It has also broken the ability to summarize an old thread which had images with a text-only model.

Please bring it back.

  1. When I try to summarize a thread

Current vs. Expected behavior

Models with text-only capabilities used to be able to continue conversations by image capable models after compaction. They were also able to summarize a thread that contained images.

Both of these are no longer possible. Please revert this behavior.
